$comment: The known differences between the Figma library and code (first full read, 2026-11-15). pnpm check:figma-parity fails on a difference that is not here, and on an entry whose difference is gone: fix the difference, then delete its entry, so this list only shrinks. An entry needs a reason a reviewer can check and the issue that removes it. Fix list: hds#1565.

collection-not-in-code:Button tone.reason: Hand-built in Figma for the condensed Button (hds#1147). No token builds it, so check:figma-drift ignores it. Move its values to tokens or accept it as Figma-only: hds#1565, Figma fix F2.
